cindyBridge.note: The Desktop Main DshControlPlane integration fixtures exercised the reviewed alpha.3 executable through the Cindy DshAcpClient and Main-owned stdio transport. The lifecycle fixture covers initialize, session/new, close, session/list/reconcile, resume, idle cancel, and close. The prompt fixture uses a fresh managed Home whose explicit ACP profile points only to a temporary loopback OpenAI-compatible mock with a deliberately fake key: it covers prompt, session/update follow scoped to the runtime session, cancellation while a streamed turn is running, the explicit ACP stopReason=cancelled result, and close. Cindy admits only end_turn or cancelled as a prompt terminal result. The bridge unit contract requires Main-injected workdir authorization, bounds every runtime-facing operation, and closes the carrier on timeout with needs-reconcile without replay. A missing jsonrpc 2.0 envelope, invalid request/response shape, malformed error response, unsafe runtime session id, or malformed UTF-8 stdout is a fail-closed protocol violation with no stdout payload preview in logs; any initialize rejection or malformed required session capability also closes the carrier. Main closes every child EOF -> bounded TERM -> bounded KILL -> bounded failure if exit remains unconfirmed; uncooperative-child, invalid-UTF-8, and no-close fake-child fixtures prove those teardown branches. Neither fixture reads a user credential or accesses the network.

observations.realBinarySmoke: passed: --version, sdk initialize, shutdown, EOF, and SIGTERM in a new temporary DSH_HOME and non-project launcher directory; no model prompt or credentials were used.
observations.acpControlProbe: passed: ACP v1 initialize advertised session close/list/resume; session/new, idle session/cancel, session/close, session/list and session/resume succeeded through a temporary managed Home and non-project launcher directory. The runtime lists a session after its active handle is closed, not while it is active. No model prompt or credentials were used.
observations.cindyBridgeIntegration: passed: apps/desktop/src/main/maker-host/__tests__/dshControlPlane.integration.test.ts ran DshControlPlane -> DshAcpClient -> Main stdio transport -> reviewed alpha.3 executable for create, close, list/reconcile, resume, idle cancel and close. The unit contract also proves an operation timeout closes the carrier, records needs-reconcile and prevents retry. It proves Main ownership and scoped receipt flow for that no-credential lifecycle only.
observations.cindyBridgePromptIntegration: passed: the opt-in real-binary test configured only a temporary ACP profile under a fresh managed Home to use a loopback OpenAI-compatible mock and fake fixture key. DshControlPlane prompt produced an ACP session/update agent_message_chunk for the owned runtime session; a second streamed turn was cancelled through the bridge, returned the validated stopReason=cancelled terminal result, and settled before close. No user credential, user DSH_HOME, user profile, or network endpoint was used.
observations.platformCoverage: darwin-arm64 only; no Linux or Windows runner result is claimed.
